title: Threaded & Socket Welded Steel Fittings - Pressure Classes vs. Schedules
description: Pressure classes, schedules and weights of pipes for threaded & socket welded fittings. Provides reference data for standard (STD), extra strong (XS), and double extra strong (XXS) schedules across different pressure classes.

components.content:
## Pipe Schedule and Designation

Threaded fittings are available in pressure classes 2000, 3000 and 6000.

Socket-welded fittings are available in pressure classes 3000, 6000 and 9000.

### Legend
- **Standard (STD)** - Standard wall thickness
- **Extra Strong (XS)** - Extra strong wall thickness
- **Double Extra Strong (XXS)** - Double extra strong wall thickness
- **Schedule** - Numbers assigned to different wall thickness of pipe (i.e. schedule 80)
